title: indigo_test: tests load libindigo, indigo_server and drivers from their own checkout regardless of LD_LIBRARY_PATH
description:
Found while closing ca925388 and its fixes (2026-11-26). The owner's shell exports LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/home/rumen/work/indigo.git/build/lib. Every test binary built in a Factory worktree (.factory2/local/worktrees/<id>) then loads the primary checkout's libindigo.so instead of the worktree's own, so 'flow check unit' in a worktree silently tests the primary checkout's library. Observed: ticket 0329a182's fixed indigo_xml.c failed test_protocol_xml.c:754 (the exact failure of the unfixed parser) until the check was rerun with LD_LIBRARY_PATH unset; earlier sub-tickets had to override it by hand.

Expected: indigo_test/Makefile targets (test-unit, the integration targets and helpers such as check-lib, and the Python runners under indigo_test/ that start indigo_server or drivers, e.g. run_scheduler_simulators.py) run against the build/lib (and build/drivers, build/bin) of the checkout that contains them, regardless of the caller's LD_LIBRARY_PATH / DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH, on Linux and macOS. Options: prepend the checkout's build/lib in the Makefile recipes and runners, or link the test binaries with an rpath that takes precedence (note LD_LIBRARY_PATH overrides DT_RUNPATH, not DT_RPATH). run_scheduler_two_servers.py (ticket ca925388) already prepends its own build/lib; reuse or align. Do not change tools/run_driver_test.py semantics without checking the recording contract in indigo_test/AGENTS.md.

Tests: a harness test showing that a test binary run with a foreign LD_LIBRARY_PATH still loads the checkout's libindigo (e.g. via ldd or a version symbol), and flow check passing in a worktree with the owner's environment.

outcome.summary: Pass. -Wl,--disable-new-dtags is added only to TEST_LDFLAGS in indigo_test/Makefile:266-268; TEST_LDFLAGS is used by no makefile outside indigo_test, so installed/packaged binaries keep DT_RUNPATH. BUILD_LIB is absolute (Makefile.inc), so the exported LD_LIBRARY_PATH/DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH (Makefile:269-270) is valid from any recipe cwd; a missing build/lib only adds a nonexistent entry; recursive makes just duplicate the entry. Statically linked tests and sanitizer builds are unaffected; test_examples.py still overrides the variables itself; valgrind leak runner gets the checkout path. Python launchers prepend only the library variables; run_driver_test.py counting/recording logic untouched. New buildsystem/test_checkout_library.py: 3 tests pass with LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/home/rumen/work/indigo.git/build/lib; with master's indigo_test/Makefile temporarily restored all 3 fail (file restored afterwards, worktree clean), and the RUNPATH control proves the reported defect. ldd of a unit binary with the foreign LD_LIBRARY_PATH resolves libindigo.so to the worktree build/lib. flow check (whitespace, unit: 78 suites, exit 0) passed with LD_LIBRARY_PATH set; test-buildsystem 24 tests, only the known unrelated test_agent_mcp_help failure. Non-blocking notes: on macOS /usr/bin/make and /bin/sh are SIP-protected and strip DYLD_* from children, so the DYLD export is mostly inert there, and test_make_puts_this_build_first passes on macOS from make's own expansion only (not a defect: macOS LC_RPATH lookup already is not overridden by a stripped DYLD path); Makefile.inc LDFLAGS carries '.' in the rpath, which as DT_RPATH now also applies to transitive dependencies of test binaries (pre-existing flag, low impact).

Re-review after indigo_test/AGENTS.md was dropped from the ticket. git diff master...HEAD is 8 files, 168 insertions, matching the previously reviewed change without indigo_test/AGENTS.md (that file has no diff against master). indigo_test/Makefile:266-270 adds -Wl,--disable-new-dtags to TEST_LDFLAGS on non-Darwin, so the existing -rpath to this checkout's build/lib is stored as DT_RPATH. That flag is only in indigo_test, so installed binaries are not affected. The same lines export LD_LIBRARY_PATH and DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH with this checkout's BUILD_LIB first and keep the caller's value after it. Nested makes may repeat the entry, which does no harm. The five Python launchers prepend their own build/lib the same way: run_scheduler_simulators.py:338, run_sequencer_simulators.py:225, run_server_leak_check.py:99, run_driver_test.py:419 and scheduler_sandbox.py:540. run_driver_test.py changes only the child environment, so the recording contract is unchanged. buildsystem/test_checkout_library.py places a decoy copy of libindigo in a foreign directory. It checks a DT_RPATH probe started directly, the make export, and a DT_RUNPATH control that loads the decoy when started directly and this build when started from a recipe. The test is sound. The pbxproj entry sits in the buildsystem group. Ran: unittest test_checkout_library.py with LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/home/rumen/work/indigo.git/build/lib, 3/3 ok. readelf on build/unit shows RPATH including the worktree's build/lib. ldd test_protocol_xml with the owner's LD_LIBRARY_PATH resolves the worktree's libindigo.so. git diff --check is clean. No defects found.

Building worktree libindigo and unit prerequisites
Running new buildsystem test test_checkout_library.py with foreign LD_LIBRARY_PATH
Check command-1 started: make -C indigo_test test-buildsystem
Check command-1 failed: 1 of 24 tests failed
